items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: And Frank Frobel, he was another cracker jack. He used to play in theater.

ctx.x: He got the job, that's the idea. Yeah. He got the job. But uh this fella that I was telling you about Eddie Falken and Klein that that fella was man that was a beautiful finals player. Uh huh.
